坐了一会儿，夜风凉了。王建新站起来，拍了拍身上的土，招呼大毛它们和小狐狸回空间。

几个家伙听见招呼，立马跑了过来。大毛跑在最前面，二毛三毛跟在后面，四毛五毛还在远处追什么，听见喊声也掉头跑回来。小狐狸从羊圈边上窜过来，四条小短腿倒腾得飞快，跑到王建新脚边，顺着裤腿往上爬。

王建新弯腰把小狐狸拎起来，放在肩膀上。然后意念一动，把大毛它们五个和小狐狸全部收入空间。

他又走过去，把那七只羊也收入空间。羊们已经习惯了，不叫不闹，乖乖地就消失了。

正准备进空间，王建新忽然感觉有细微的嘈杂声。

不是风声，不是草声，是人声。很轻，很远，但炼气三层的听觉捕捉到了。还有脚步声，踩在草地上的声音，虽然很轻，但不止一个人。

他停住了脚步，仔细感应。

声音从北边来，铁丝网那个方向。人数不少，至少十个以上。

“又有越境者。”王建新心里一紧，“难道是过来报复的？”

他意念一动，进了空间。站在透明雾墙边上，往外观察。空间里的光线不会泄露到外面，外面的人看不见他，他却能把外面看得清清楚楚。

等了大约半个小时。远远的，月光下，一队人摸黑朝着这边过来。他们走得很小心，猫着腰，脚步很轻，不仔细看根本发现不了。但王建新的视力好，在月光下跟白天差不多，看得一清二楚。

一个人，两个人，三个……他数了数，一共十二个。

“这是来了一个班吗？”王建新仔细看了看，发现他们都带着枪支。AKM步枪，跟上次那些人的装备一样。穿着深色的衣服，脸上抹了黑灰，看不清长相。

幸亏今天他回来了。要是他还在公社，赵国强那小子一个人在这儿，遇到这十二个武装分子，赵国强就得交代在这里。

王建新从武器库里拿出五六半，检查了一下子弹，压满。然后出了空间，利用空间挪移，悄悄地隐藏在一处草地上。离土坯房不远不近，视野开阔，正好能打到那队人的侧面。

那队人越来越近。他们已经能看见土坯房了，放慢了速度，散开了，成一个扇形，慢慢包围过来。

王建新端起枪，瞄准了领头的那个人。

距离差不多了。他屏住呼吸，扣动了扳机。

“砰——”

第一枪，领头的人应声倒下。王建新没有停，快速拉枪栓，退壳，上膛，瞄准，扣扳机。一枪接一枪，连续打了四枪。

“砰——砰——砰——砰——”

四个人的身影倒了下去。剩下的七个人听到枪响，立马趴下，开始顺着枪声的方向开枪。子弹从王建新头顶飞过去，打在身后的草地上，噗噗噗地响。

王建新开了枪就换了位置。他利用空间挪移，在十米范围内瞬移，瞬间就换到了另一处草地，趴在草丛里。

那七个人还在朝他刚才的位置开枪，打得不亦乐乎。

王建新端枪，瞄准，又打了两枪。

“砰——砰——”

又两个人倒了下去。剩下的五个人慌了，枪声乱了，有的还在朝他刚才的位置打，有的已经开始往后退。

王建新想了想，得留活口。全打死了，上面问起来，连个口供都没有。他瞄准那些人的手臂，一枪一个。

“砰——砰——砰——砰——砰——”

十枪，十个手臂。惨叫声在夜空中响起，此起彼伏。五个人全部中弹，枪掉了，趴在地上打滚。

王建新端着五六半，慢慢靠近。他随时感知着周围，确定没有其他人了，才走到那五个人跟前。

月光下，他能看清这些人的脸了。都是青壮年，脸上涂着黑灰，穿着深色的军服。一看就是训练有素的士兵，不是普通的偷渡客。

王建新用蒙语问道：“你们来这里干什么？”

没人回答。那五个人趴在地上，有的闭着眼睛，有的瞪着他，但谁也不开口。

王建新举起枪，对准其中一个人的脑袋，又用蒙语问了一遍：“你们来这里干什么？”

还是不开口。王建新扣动了扳机。

“砰——”

那个人头一歪，不动了。

王建新把枪口对准下一个，又问了一遍。这个人咬了咬牙，还是不说。王建新又开了一枪。

“砰——”

又倒了一个。

活着的仅剩三个人了。王建新观察了一下，发现其中有一个人身子在发抖，虽然咬着牙，但腿抖得厉害。

王建新把枪口对准他，问：“你们来这里干什么？”

那个人看了看旁边两个同伴，又看了看王建新，嘴唇哆嗦着，终于开口了。

“过来……过来抓几个巡边人员回去。”他的蒙语带着口音，但能听懂。

“抓人回去干嘛？”王建新问。

“一个是审问一些具体情况，”那人咽了口唾沫，“再一个需要和中国交换人质。”

王建新问：“你们一共来了多少人？”

“来了一个班，十二个人。”

“还有没有别的人？”

那人犹豫了一下。王建新把枪口往前顶了顶，直接顶在他脑门上。

“还有！还有！”那人赶紧说，“还有两个班，去另外两个巡边站了。”

王建新一听，急了。

另外两个巡边站，一个是红旗哨点，就是离他最近的那个，大概三十来里地。还有一个更远的，在另一个方向，六十来里。那两个哨点各有一个巡边员。

十二个人来他这里，十二个人去红旗哨点，十二个人去那个更远的哨点。一个排，三个班，分三路。

“妈的。”王建新骂了一声。

他抬起枪，对着地上那三个人的腿，一人两枪。

“砰——砰——砰——砰——砰——砰——”

六声枪，三个人的双腿全部被打穿。惨叫声在草原的夜里非常凄厉，传出去老远。那三个人在地上翻滚，有的已经疼晕过去了。

王建新不管他们，转身就跑。他跑回土坯房，冲进去，拿起步谈机开始呼叫。

After sitting for a while, the night breeze became cold.Wang Jianxin stood up, patted the dirt on his body, and called Big Mao, the others, and the little fox back to space.

Several guys heard the greeting and ran over immediately.Da Mao ran in front, followed by Er Mao and San Mao. Forty and Fifty Mao were still chasing something in the distance. When they heard the shouts, they turned around and ran back.The little fox scurried over from the edge of the sheepfold, its four short legs flying very fast, and ran to Wang Jianxin's feet, climbing up his trouser legs.

Wang Jianxin bent down to pick up the little fox and put it on his shoulders.Then with a thought, he put all the five big cats and the little fox into the space.

He walked over again and took the seven sheep into the space.The sheep have become accustomed to it, and they disappear obediently without barking or fussing.

Just as he was about to enter the space, Wang Jianxin suddenly felt a slight noise.

It's not the sound of wind or grass, it's the sound of people.It was very light and far away, but the hearing of the third level of Qi Refining caught it.There were also footsteps and the sound of stepping on the grass. Although it was very light, there was more than one person.

He stopped and sensed carefully.

The sound came from the north, the direction of the barbed wire fence.There were quite a few people, at least ten or more.

"There are people crossing the border again." Wang Jianxin felt nervous, "Did they come here for revenge?"

With a thought, he entered the space.Stand next to the transparent fog wall and look out.The light in the space will not leak to the outside. People outside cannot see him, but he can see the outside clearly.

Waited for about half an hour.In the distance, under the moonlight, a group of people came towards this side in the dark.They walked very carefully, their waists were bent, and their steps were so light that you couldn't even notice them unless you looked carefully.But Wang Jianxin's eyesight is good, and he can see clearly under the moonlight, which is almost the same as during the day.

One person, two people, three... He counted, twelve in total.

"Is this the same class here?" Wang Jianxin looked carefully and found that they all carried guns.AKM rifles, the same equipment as those last time.Wearing dark clothes, his face was smeared with black ash, and his appearance could not be seen clearly.

Fortunately he is back today.If he was still in the commune and that boy Zhao Guoqiang was here alone, and met these twelve armed men, Zhao Guoqiang would have to explain himself here.

Wang Jianxin took out five or six halves from the weapons arsenal, checked the bullets, and found that they were full.Then he left the space, used the space to move, and quietly hid on the grass.It was not far or close to the adobe house, and the view was wide, just enough to hit the side of the group of people.

The group of people was getting closer.They could already see the adobe houses, slowed down, spread out, formed a fan shape, and slowly surrounded them.

Wang Jianxin raised his gun and aimed at the leader.

The distance is almost there.He held his breath and pulled the trigger.

"Bang——"

With the first shot, the leader fell down.Wang Jianxin did not stop, quickly pulled the bolt, ejected the gun, loaded the gun, took aim, and pulled the trigger.One shot after another, four shots in a row.

"Bang-bang-bang-bang-"

Four figures fell down.When the remaining seven people heard the gunshot, they immediately fell down and started shooting in the direction of the gunshot.The bullet flew over Wang Jianxin's head and hit the grass behind him with a pop-pop sound.

Wang Jianxin changed positions after firing.He used space to move, teleporting within ten meters, and instantly moved to another grassland, lying down in the grass.

The seven men were still shooting at where he was just now, and they were having fun.

Wang Jianxin picked up the gun, took aim, and fired two more shots.

"Bang-bang-"

Two more people fell.The remaining five people panicked, and the gunfire was chaotic. Some were still shooting at his previous position, and some had already begun to retreat.

Wang Jianxin thought about it and decided to stay alive.They were all beaten to death, but when asked by the superiors, they didn't even get a confession.He aimed at the men's arms and shot them one at a time.

"Bang-bang-bang-bang-bang-"

Ten guns, ten arms.Screams rang out in the night sky, one after another.All five men were shot, dropped their guns, and rolled on the ground.

Wang Jianxin, holding five or six halves, slowly approached.He sensed his surroundings at all times to make sure there was no one else, then walked up to the five people.

Under the moonlight, he could see the faces of these people clearly.They were all young and middle-aged men, with their faces painted black and gray and wearing dark military uniforms.At first glance, he looks like a well-trained soldier, not an ordinary stowaway.

Wang Jianxin asked in Mongolian: "What are you doing here?"

No one answered.The five people were lying on the ground, some with their eyes closed, some staring at him, but no one spoke.

Wang Jianxin raised his gun, pointed it at one of the men's heads, and asked again in Mongolian: "What are you doing here?"

Still didn't speak.Wang Jianxin pulled the trigger.

"Bang——"

The man tilted his head and stopped moving.

Wang Jianxin pointed his gun at the next one and asked again.The man gritted his teeth and still didn't say anything.Wang Jianxin fired another shot.

"Bang——"

Another one fell.

Only three people were left alive.Wang Jianxin observed it and found that one of the people was shaking. Although he gritted his teeth, his legs were shaking violently.

Wang Jianxin pointed his gun at him and asked, "What are you doing here?"

The man looked at the two companions next to him, then at Wang Jianxin, his lips trembled, and finally spoke.

"Come here... come here and take some border guards back." His Mongolian was accented, but he could understand it.

"What are you arresting people for?" Wang Jianxin asked.

"One is to interrogate some specific situations," the man swallowed. "The other is to exchange hostages with China."

Wang Jianxin asked: "How many people are here in total?"

"A class came, twelve people."

"Is there anyone else?"

The man hesitated.Wang Jianxin pushed the muzzle of the gun forward, directly against his head.

"There are more! There are more!" The man said quickly, "There are still two more classes, and they are going to the other two border patrol stations."

When Wang Jianxin heard this, he became anxious.

There are two other border patrol stations, one is the red flag sentry station, which is the one closest to him, about thirty miles away.There is another one farther away, in the other direction, about sixty miles away.There is a lineman at each of those two posts.

Twelve people came to him, twelve people went to the red flag sentry point, and twelve people went to the farther sentry point.One platoon, three classes, three routes.

"Damn it." Wang Jianxin cursed.

He raised his gun and aimed at the legs of the three people on the ground, shooting each of them twice.

"Bang-bang-bang-bang-bang-bang-"

Six shots were fired, and all three people's legs were shot through.The screams were very loud in the night on the grassland and could be heard far away.The three people were rolling on the ground, and some had fainted from the pain.

Wang Jianxin ignored them and ran away.He ran back to the adobe house, rushed inside, picked up the walkie-talkie and started calling.
